response:
For webcam/camera connectivity issues during the compatibility check:

1. Test your webcam at https://webcamtests.com/ to verify it functions correctly.
2. Uninstall any virtual camera software (e.g., OBS Virtual Camera, Snap Camera) that may conflict.
3. Ensure system permissions are enabled:
   - Windows: Camera access in Privacy settings
   - macOS: Webcam, system events, screen recording, and accessibility access in System Preferences > Security & Privacy
4. Disconnect all external monitors — HackerRank Desktop App Mode supports only a single display.
5. Close all other applications before launching the HackerRank Desktop App.
6. If the test window appears blank or unresponsive, refresh:
   - Windows: Ctrl + R
   - Mac: Command (⌘) + R
7. Install the HackerRank Desktop App at least 30 minutes before the test.
8. Use a laptop connected to a power source to prevent interruptions.

If the issue persists after these steps, contact support@hackerrank.com.
justification: Document 1 covers webcam testing, virtual camera removal, and environment preparation. Document 3 details system permissions for Windows/macOS, single-display requirement, app installation timing, and refresh troubleshooting. Both are in the Screen / Test Integrity category.
